places.name: Clara's ranch
places.note: Clara kisses Augustus, cares for her injured husband and July's baby, and sells Call horses at a stiff price, gifting Newt a sorrel.
places.location_hint: horse ranch on the Platte in Nebraska, near Ogallala; the riders approach from the north side of the river

places.name: North Platte River
places.note: The visitors cross it to Clara's; the party picnics under cottonwoods three miles west along it, and the girls and Newt wade.
places.location_hint: picnic spot about three miles west of Clara's ranch

places.name: Place where Ellie Johnson was killed
places.note: A soldier tells of a woman and a hide hunter slain by Indians here; July believes the woman was his wife.
places.location_hint: about sixty miles east of Ogallala, Nebraska, on the plains

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Clara says Augustus could have done his drinking there and been a friend to her; Call's horses there were inferior to hers.

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Clara feels she has earned some liveliness after years there; Newt thinks it has plenty of room for cattle.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Augustus says Lorena came all the way from there, and that he spent most of fifteen years there drinking.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

places.name: Montana
places.note: Clara warns it is unsafe and urges waiting; she tells Newt he can come back to work if it doesn't suit him.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Call reckons Montana can't be rougher than Texas once was.

places.name: Guadalupe River
places.note: Clara and Augustus once picnicked at a spot on it they called her orchard.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: Call asks July if he came from there, and whether he will go back.

places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: July's hometown, where he set out long ago chasing Jake Spoon.

places.name: Kansas
places.note: Call tells July they caught and hanged Jake there among a bad gang.

places.name: Dodge City
places.note: July had horse trouble near there while pursuing Jake.

groups.label: Clara's household
groups.hint: at the ranch house and horse lots on the Platte

groups.label: Visitors from the herd
groups.hint: Call and Newt at the lots collecting the bought horses
